checks: Story existence/title/type; quote contiguous substring in saved API tree AND original archive; API author exact, archive author matched or difference explicitly recorded; API containment; archive parent preserved.
archive_precedence: Monthly snapshots authoritative; incremental data only for IDs not in monthly snapshots.

normalization.html_blocks: Parse HTML, separate block tags, collapse whitespace.
normalization.legacy_strip_tags: Remove tags, decode entities, collapse whitespace. Retained for researcher quotation compatibility.

author_difference_notes.identity_resolution: Unresolved display-name difference; both labels retained.
Unresolved display-name difference; both labels retained.

parent_difference_interpretation: HN can move or merge discussions between snapshots. A parent mismatch is preserved rather than treated as a quote-text failure; the archived ID and quote still have to match, and both author labels are retained.
